description: This file contains a Python class 'LunaryLogger' for logging events to the 'lunary.ai' platform, including functions for parsing usage data, tool calls, and messages, as well as methods for logging events with detailed metadata.

classes.name: LunaryLogger
classes.description: A class responsible for logging events to the lunary.ai platform, handling event data, metadata, and error reporting.

methods.name: parse_usage
methods.description: Parses usage dictionary to extract completion and prompt tokens.

methods.name: parse_tool_calls
methods.description: Processes a list of tool call objects into serialized dictionaries.

methods.name: parse_messages
methods.description: Cleans and serializes message input, handling nested messages and tool calls.
